{{Quote|Moffs, Generals! Today you will see who holds the real power in the Sith Empire, not the Dark Council, not Thanaton, me. When I finish my ascent all will bow, or face my might.|[[Sith Lord/Legends|Lord]] [[Darth Nox|Kallig's]] declaration to powerbase members|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
'''Kallig's powerbase''' was the successor of Zash's powerbase, led by [[Darth Zash]]'s former [[Sith apprentice/Legends|apprentice]] [[Darth Nox|Lord Kallig]], the future Darth Nox.

It comprised of Sith, members of the [[Imperial Military (Sith Empire)|Imperial Military]], the [[Imperial Reclamation Service]] and the [[Cult of the Screaming Blade]]  and served the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] and [[Galactic War]] under the dominion of the [[Sphere of Ancient Knowledge]] and its [[Dark Council]] member.

==History==
{{Quote|This ends now. I declare a Kaggath, a contest of mutual annihilation pitting powerbase against powerbase. Whoever sheds the most blood wins. To the victor: eternal glory. To the loser: death and shame.|[[Darth Thanaton]] to [[Sith Lord/Legends|Lord]] [[Darth Nox|Kallig]], declaring his ill fated final attempt to eradicate Kallig's powerbase|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic" />}}
[[Sith Lord/Legends|Lord]] [[Darth Nox|Kallig's]] powerbase was founded while Kallig was [[Sith apprentice/Legends|apprentice]] to [[Darth Zash]], and the young apprentice usurped control of the [[Cult of the Screaming Blade]] from its leader, the renegade Sith Lord [[Paladius]].

After the demise of [[Darth Zash]], as her apprentice Lord Kallig took possession of her assets and followers in a powerbase under the domain of the [[Sphere of Ancient Knowledge]].

Shortly after the establishment of this powerbase, [[Sith Lord/Legends|Lord]] [[Darth Nox|Kallig's]] superior [[Darth Thanaton]] order it to be [[Purge of Zash's powerbase|purged]], due to its alignment with [[Darth Zash]]. Ultimately the powerbase survived the purge and an exasperated Darth Thanaton, by then a [[Dark Council]] member, declared a [[Kaggath (Galactic War)|Kaggath]] against his [[Spheres of Influence|Sphere's]] subordinate powerbase, and its leader Lord Kallig. By this time Kallig had expanded the powerbase significantly, not only gaining powerful followers in the Imperial Military, notably [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Valion Pyron]], but completing the [[Silencer (superweapon)|Silencer project]], a [[Superweapon/Legends|superweapon]] brainchild of the long dead [[Darth Mekhis]].

Lord Kallig defeated Thanaton in most major confrontations in the Kaggath, and the two finally [[Second duel on Corellia|dueled]] publicly on [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]] in front of [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] and [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Imperials]]. When it became apparent that Kallig had attained the advantage, Darth Thanaton fled to Korriban to seek the aid of the Dark Council. Kallig followed Thanaton to Korriban and fought their way to the Dark Council chamber where Thanaton was making his pleas to unreceptive [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lords]]. The two once more fought, and Kallig defeated Thanaton decisively. The latter was executed by [[Darth Mortis]], who immediately offered Kallig Thanaton's Dark Council seat.

Kallig was raised to the position of Darth, and given the title [[Darth Nox]]. With the accession of Nox to the Dark Council, the powerbase disestablished and fully assimilated into the Sphere of Ancient Knowledge.
